name: Loops
briefs: Write exactly one English activation email from the Loops team. Reader: A SaaS operator who just opened a Loops account and already has a CSV of subscribers. Ask them to do one thing: Import the first contacts from that CSV. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.

Write exactly one English activation email from the Loops team. Reader: A developer with a Loops account and a draft transactional template. Ask them to do one thing: Run a first transactional email test to their own address. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.
